# Validate gate names, coordinates and populations

```{r load flowJo workspace} 
wsfile = file.path(fcsDir, "B cell panel/B cell_gating/2024-04-18 D4/Sandbox_2024-04-18_B cell_hierarchical_ALLparameter_Gates_D4.wsp")

summary(ws)

                                  path = file.path(fcsDir, "all_bcell_fcs"))

plot(gs_flowJo)


nodelist = gs_get_pop_paths(gs_flowJo, path = 1)
print(nodelist) #bringing in CD27 + updated RBD+ gating pathway 04 Sep 2025 - check that the nodelist is correct
```

```{r load the annotations}
annotations_ = read_excel("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/tables/annotation_cleaned.xlsx", sheet = 1)

# add a column ALid that is "AL" + the number, make sure the number is three digits, with leading zeros if needed

annotations = dplyr::filter(annotations, !is.na(ALId))
```

```{r load the fcs files}
```

```{r create the design matrix}
fcsFiles = list.files(file.path(fcsDir, "all_bcell_fcs"), pattern = ".fcs$", full.names = TRUE)
design = data.frame(fcsFiles = fcsFiles)

design$fcsName = basename(design$fcsFiles)
design$sampleName = gsub(".fcs", "", design$fcsName)
```

```{r add annotations to the design matrix}
# extract ALnumber from design$sample_name
design$ALId = gsub(".*AL([0-9]+).*", "AL\\1", design$sample)

design$control = str_detect(design$sampleName, "IC")
design$ALId[design$control] = NA

design = merge(design, annotations, by = "ALId", all.x = TRUE)

setdiff(annotations$ALId, design$ALId)
```

```{r add batch ID to design matrix}

# add batch ID to design matrix:
batch_ids1 = as.numeric(gsub(".*Batch([0-9]+).*", "\\1", design$sampleName))
batch_ids2 = as.numeric(gsub(".*B([0-9]+).*", "\\1", design$sampleName))
design$batch = batch_ids1
design$batch[!is.na(batch_ids2)] = batch_ids2[!is.na(batch_ids2)]

# identify study groups
design$group = ifelse(grepl("PRE|Pre", design$sample), "pre", "enriched")
```


```{r get gates and transformations}
# get the controls
samples = data.frame(samplename = sampleNames(gs_flowJo))
samples$batch = as.numeric(gsub(".*Batch([0-9]+).*", "\\1", samples$samplename))
samples$group = ifelse(grepl("PRE", samples$samplename), "pre", "enriched")

samples = dplyr::filter(samples, str_detect(samples$samplename, "IC"))

# start building out gates
gates = list() #initializes nested list to store gate definitions
trans = list() #initializes nested list to store transformation fxn
for (group_ in c("pre", "enriched")) {
  gates[[group_]] = list()
  trans[[group_]] = list()
}

for (iControl in 1:nrow(samples)) {
  group_ = samples$group[iControl]
  batch_ = samples$batch[iControl]
  
  gates_ = list()
  for (i in 2:length(nodelist)) {
    gates_[[i]] = gs_pop_get_gate(gs_flowJo, nodelist[i])[[iControl]]
  }
  
  gates[[group_]][[batch_]] = gates_
  
  trans_ = gh_get_transformations(gs_flowJo[[iControl]])
  trans[[group_]][[batch_]] <- transformList(from = names(trans_), trans_)
}

```


```{r transform fcs files}
fcs_transformed_directory = file.path(fcsDir, "transformed_flow_data", "B_cell_panel")

design$transformedFcs = file.path(fcs_transformed_directory, design$fcsName)

# The first time I analyze this data set, I am actually loading and transforming the data

paths_ = unique(dirname(design$transformedFcs))
for (path_ in paths_) {
  dir.create(path_, showWarnings = F, recursive = T)
}

# Everytime we get a new gating set/workspace, we need to transform the fcs files again.
for (iRow in 1:nrow(design)) {
  print(iRow)
  if (file.exists(design$transformedFcs[iRow])) {
  next #if transformed file already exists, ccode skips it
  }
  ff = read.FCS(design$fcsFiles[iRow], truncate_max_range = TRUE) #if trans doesn't exist, it reads raw fcs file, 
  # ff = read.FCS(design$fcs_file[iRow], truncate_max_range = FALSE)
  ff_t = flowCore::transform(ff, trans[[design$group[iRow]]][[design$batch[iRow]]]) #applies appropriate trans for that sample's gorup & batch
  
  write.FCS(ff_t, file = design$transformedFcs[iRow]) # this code moves fcs files from all_bcell_fcs to the newly created B_cell_panel folder
}
```

```{setup gating sets}
# After organizing the gates, we need to organize the fcs files into gating sets
# instead of making folders and using symboling links (cyto_setup needs a folder to read files in)
# let's see if we can build the gs objects with flowCore (flowSet() and GatingSet() )

gs = list() #initialize empty gating set list
for (sample in c("pre", "enriched")) {
  gs[[sample]] = list()
}

for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    samples_ = dplyr::filter(design, group == group_, batch == batch_)
    
    print(paste0("group: ", group_, " batch: ", batch_, " samples: ", nrow(samples_)))
    flowSet = read.flowSet(dplyr::filter(design, group == group_,
                                         batch == batch_)$transformedFcs,
                           truncate_max_range = FALSE)
    
    gs[[group_]][[batch_]] = GatingSet(flowSet)
  }
}
```

```{r gate }
print(nodelist)
# barcode appears to be the fourth node, let's check:
gate_ids = which(nodelist %in% c("Live_Stringent", "LYM", "Barcode"))
names(gate_ids) = c("Live_Stringent", "LYM", "Barcode")

for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    parent_node = "root"
    
    for (i in gate_ids[1:length(gate_ids)] ) {
      gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]], parent = parent_node)
      parent_node = paste(parent_node, gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]]@filterId, sep = "/")
    }
  }
}

```

```{r gate for the remaining nodes}
# now we need to add CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB to the root path from above
gate_ids = which(nodelist %in% c("CD19+ dump-", "B cells", "PB"))
names(gate_ids) = c("CD19+ dump-", "B cells", "PB")
gate_ids


# resolve the PB gate
for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[gate_ids["PB"]]]@filterId = "PB+"
  }
}

names(gate_ids)[names(gate_ids) == "PB"] = "PB+"

# the gate we want in the end, is the non-PB cells. I renamed the gate called PB in the workspace to PB+.
# so we can use the PB+ gate to create a PB- gate. Since Ambers files all reference PB as the non-PB cells, I am
# going to call what is the PB- gate PB in my gating. This will make it easier for me to compare counts between 
# her spreadsheets and mine
# Now what was initially confusing is that the PB gate in the workspace is actually the PB+ gate. But in Ambers data, what I would think of as the PB- gate is called PB. Just something to keep in mind...flowJo seems to not clearly handle the logic part of that gate?
PBgate = booleanFilter(`!PB+`, filterId = 'PB')

root = parent_node
# starting point should now be /Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/
root

for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    parent_node = root
    
    # root path everything but the PB+ gate (since we don't want that as part of the path)
    for (i in gate_ids[1:(length(gate_ids) - 1)] ) {
      gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]], parent = parent_node)
      parent_node = paste(parent_node, gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]]@filterId, sep = "/")
    }
    
    # add PB+ and PB gates
    gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[gate_ids["PB+"]]], parent = parent_node)
    gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], PBgate, parent = parent_node)
    
    parent_node = paste(parent_node, PBgate@filterId, sep = "/")
    }
}

parent_node

# now add the remaining few gates:

gate_ids = which(nodelist %in% c("Q1: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700+", 
                                 "Q2: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700+", 
                                 "Q3: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700-", 
                                 "Q4: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700-"))
gate_ids
nodelist[gate_ids]

# this time we want to add to "Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB"
# remember PB is actually a PB- logical gate
parent_node

# add the 20 level 1 nodes to the gating set
for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    for (i in gate_ids) {
      gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]], parent = parent_node)
    }
  }
}

```

# IMPACD gating

After validation of the gates, we can now kick off IMPACD!
```{r set up clean gating sets again}
# Best to set up clean gating sets again

gs = list()
for (sample in c("pre", "enriched")) {
  gs[[sample]] = list()
}

for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    samples_ = dplyr::filter(design, group == group_, batch == batch_)
    
    print(paste0("group: ", group_, " batch: ", batch_, " samples: ", nrow(samples_)))
    flowSet = read.flowSet(dplyr::filter(design, group == group_,
                                         batch == batch_)$transformedFcs,
                           truncate_max_range = FALSE)
    
    gs[[group_]][[batch_]] = GatingSet(flowSet)
  }
}
```

## IMPACD on root path: live stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+dump-/B cells/non-PBs
```{r gate the root path}
# [live stringent > LYM > Barcode > CD19+dump- > B cells > non-PBs] 

print(nodelist)
# barcode appears to be the fourth node, let's check:
gate_ids = which(nodelist %in% c("Live_Stringent", "LYM", "Barcode", "CD19+ dump-", "B cells", "PB"))
names(gate_ids) = c("Live_Stringent", "LYM", "Barcode", "CD19+ dump-", "B cells", "PB")

# resolve the PB gate
for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[gate_ids["PB"]]]@filterId = "PB+"
  }
}

names(gate_ids)[names(gate_ids) == "PB"] = "PB+"

# the gate we want in the end, is the non-PB cells. I renamed the gate called PB in the workspace to PB+.
# so we can use the PB+ gate to create a PB- gate. Since Ambers files all reference PB as the non-PB cells, I am
# going to call what is the PB- gate PB in my gating. This will make it easier for me to compare counts between 
# her spreadsheets and mine
# Now what was initially confusing is that the PB gate in the workspace is actually the PB+ gate. But in Ambers data, what I would think of as the PB- gate is called PB. Just something to keep in mind...flowJo seems to not clearly handle the logic part of that gate?
PBgate = booleanFilter(`!PB+`, filterId = 'PB')

for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    parent_node = "root"
    
    # root path everything but the PB+ gate (since we don't want that as part of the path)
    for (i in gate_ids[1:(length(gate_ids) - 1)] ) {
      gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]], parent = parent_node)
      parent_node = paste(parent_node, gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]]@filterId, sep = "/")
    }
    
    # add PB+ and PB gates
    gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[gate_ids["PB+"]]], parent = parent_node)
    gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], PBgate, parent = parent_node)
    
    parent_node = paste(parent_node, PBgate@filterId, sep = "/")
    }
}

root_path = parent_node
```

```{r setup for gating of first rootpath}

# get the right 20 nodes again
level1_nodes = nodelist[c(5,6,15:length(nodelist))]
level1_nodes

gate_ids = which(nodelist %in% level1_nodes)
names(gate_ids) = level1_nodes

# create the list object with batch/sampletype specific gates that we can feed to IMPACD for the permutational gating
level1_gates = list()
for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  level1_gates[[group_]] = list()
  
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    level1_gates[[group_]][[batch_]] = gates[[group_]][[batch_]][gate_ids]
    names(level1_gates[[group_]][[batch_]]) = names(gate_ids)
  }
}


# Besides the list of gates, we also need a gate "metadata frame". Below is the example from
# the IMPACD documentation. Since we aren't going to use the metadata for building the gates,
# we can make most columns NAs, we will just need the logical "gate" column, which, fortunately for us
# is going to be all FALSE, since the only logical gate (PB) is part of the root path 
# and was handled outside of IMPACD
# head(gate_data)
# name gate_type marker1 marker2 original_gate_position logical_gate transformed_gate_position
# 1 CD49b+        1D Dy161Di             76.400000000000006        FALSE              c(138.34....
# 2 CD49b-        1D Dy161Di             76.400000000000006        FALSE              c(138.34....
gatemetadata = data.frame(name = level1_nodes, 
                          gate_type = "2D", 
                          marker1 = NA, 
                          marker2 = NA, 
                          original_gate_position = NA, 
                          logical_gate = FALSE, 
                          transformed_gate_position = NA)
```


```{r run IMPACD for level 1}
# change root path to "root/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB+"
root_path <-"root/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB+"
# do the stage 1 gating
for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    message(paste0("Stage 1 gating for batch ", batch_, " in group ", group_))
    level1_paths = level1Gating(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], 
                                level1_nodes, 
                                gatemetadata, level1_gates[[group_]][[batch_]], 
                                root_path) 
  }
}
```

```{r run full IMPACD on first root path}
population_counts = list()
for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  population_counts[[group_]] = list()
  
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    message(paste0("Stage 2 gating for batch ", batch_, " in group ", group_))
    level2_paths = level2Gating(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], 
                                level1_nodes, gatemetadata, level1_gates[[group_]][[batch_]], 
                                root_path,
                                max_depth = 3,
                                level1_nodes = level1_nodes,
                                cellcountCutoff = 0) 
    
    pop_counts_ = gs_pop_get_count_fast(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], format = "long")
    population_counts[[group_]][[batch_]] = pop_counts_
  }
}
```

```{r summarize counts and save}
counts = c()
for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  counts_ = bind_rows(population_counts[[group_]])
  counts_$group = group_
  counts = rbind(counts, counts_)
}
counts$PercentParent = counts$Count/counts$ParentCount*100
counts$PercentParent[is.na(counts$PercentParent)] = NA

counts$rootPath = root_path

# save to file
```

## IMPACD on root path: live stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+dump-/B cells/RBD+/PB+
```{r add node for antigen specific cells}
## IMPACD on root path: .../CD19+ dump-/B cells/RBD+
# Start from B cells, not PB
parent_node <- sub("/PB$", "", root_path)  # turns .../B cells/PB -> .../B cells
parent_node <-"root/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells"
# We need both ids: RBD+ and PB (the FlowJo "PB" object in `gates` has already been relabeled to "PB+" earlier)
gate_ids <- which(nodelist %in% c("RBD+","PB"))
names(gate_ids) <- c("RBD+","PB")

# 1) Add RBD+ under B cells; then PB+ and boolean PB under that RBD+
for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    # add RBD+ under B cells
    gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[ gate_ids["RBD+"] ]], parent = parent_node)

    # add PB+ and PB (!PB+) under that RBD+
    rbd_parent <- paste(parent_node, "RBD+", sep = "/")
    gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[ gate_ids["PB"] ]], parent = rbd_parent)  # this object now has filterId "PB+"
    gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], PBgate, parent = rbd_parent)  # PB = non-PB (boolean)
  }
}

# 2) Set antigen-specific root for the upcoming IMPACD pass
root_path <- paste(parent_node, "RBD+", "PB+", sep = "/")

# 3) ATTACH QUADRANTS under BOTH PB parents (antigen-specific and all_Bcells)
# quad_nodes <- c(
#   "Q1: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700+",
#   "Q2: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700+",
#   "Q3: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700-",
#   "Q4: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700-"
# )
# quad_ids <- which(nodelist %in% quad_nodes)

# for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {

#     # antigen-specific PB
#     ag_parent   <- root_path                                    # .../B cells/RBD+/PB
#     # all_Bcells PB (sibling branch)
#     all_parent  <- paste(parent_node, "PB+", sep = "/")           # .../B cells/PB
# 
#     # add quads under antigen-specific PB
#     for (i in quad_ids) {
#       gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]], parent = ag_parent)
#     }
#     # add quads under all_Bcells PB
#     for (i in quad_ids) {
#       gs_pop_add(gs[[group_]][[batch_]], gates[[group_]][[batch_]][[i]], parent = all_parent)
#     }
# 
#     recompute(gs[[group_]][[batch_]])
#   }
# }
# pick the intended Stage-1 root (trim spaces just in case)
# pick the intended Stage-1 root (trim spaces just in case)

# --- define the bad paths (leaf then branch) ---
bad_leafs   <- c(
  "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB+/RBD+/PB+",
  "root/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB+/RBD+/PB+"
)
bad_branches <- c(
  "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB+/RBD+",
  "root/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB+/RBD+"
)

for (group_ in unique(design$group)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    gs_sub <- gs[[group_]][[batch_]]

    # 1) TRY GatingSet-level removal (correct arg name: node=)
    for (node_ in c(bad_leafs, bad_branches)) {
      suppressWarnings(try(gs_pop_remove(gs_sub, node = node_), silent = TRUE))
    }

    # 2) FALLBACK: remove per-sample GatingHierarchy
    for (sn in sampleNames(gs_sub)) {
      gh <- gs_sub[[sn]]
      for (node_ in c(bad_leafs, bad_branches)) {
        suppressWarnings(try(gh_pop_remove(gh, node = node_), silent = TRUE))
      }
    }

    # 3) VERIFY nothing under .../PB+/RBD+ remains
    paths_after <- gh_get_pop_paths(gs_sub[[1]], path = "auto", showHidden = TRUE)
    if (any(grepl("/B cells/PB\\+/RBD\\+($|/)", paths_after))) {
      stop("PB+/RBD+ subtree still present after removal; check template/parent fields.")
    }
  }
}
```

## GLM analysis
```{r prep the matrices}
# Prep percent parent
cellSubsets = data.frame(subset = parentCounts$subset )
cellSubsets$depth = str_count(cellSubsets$subset, "/") + 1

nodes_mat = str_split(cellSubsets$subset, "/", simplify = T) 

cellSubsets$leafNode = NA
cellSubsets$modifier1 = NA
cellSubsets$modifier2 = NA

for (iSubset in 1:nrow(cellSubsets)) {
  if (cellSubsets$depth[iSubset] == 1) {
    cellSubsets$leafNode[iSubset] = nodes_mat[iSubset, 1]
  } else if (cellSubsets$depth[iSubset] == 2){
    cellSubsets$leafNode[iSubset] = nodes_mat[iSubset, 2]
    cellSubsets$modifier1[iSubset] = nodes_mat[iSubset, 1]
  } else if (cellSubsets$depth[iSubset] == 3){
    cellSubsets$leafNode[iSubset] = nodes_mat[iSubset, 3]
    cellSubsets$modifier1[iSubset] = nodes_mat[iSubset, 1]
    cellSubsets$modifier2[iSubset] = nodes_mat[iSubset, 2]
  }
}


rownames(pctParent) = pctParent$subset
pctParent = dplyr::select(pctParent, -subset)
pctParent = pctParent[match(cellSubsets$subset, rownames(pctParent)), 
                      match(design$sampleName,  colnames(pctParent))]

# Prep parentCount
rownames(parentCounts) = parentCounts$subset
parentCounts = dplyr::select(parentCounts, -subset)
parentCounts = parentCounts[match(cellSubsets$subset, rownames(parentCounts)), 
                            match(design$sampleName,  colnames(parentCounts))]

# we also need to normalize the counts to CPM of compartment
# not using the CPM for now, but keeping the code here for future reference

# parentCount_CPM[is.na(parentCount_CPM)] = 0

# Prep counts

counts = dplyr::select(counts, -subset)
counts = counts[match(cellSubsets$subset, rownames(counts)), 
                match(design$sampleName,     colnames(counts))]

# check if there are any NAs in pctParent (there should)
sum(is.na(pctParent))
```

```{r run the full analysis}
models = list()
#initialize a progress bar
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(pctParent), style = 3)
i = 0

zeroCounts = c()
# instead of checking this here, we should probably count the pct parents and parent and actual counts, add them as columns to the cellSubsets data frame and then loop over that

for (subset_ in row.names(pctParent)) {
  # update the progress bar
  i = i + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  
  data = data.frame(sampleName = colnames(pctParent),
                    # pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,])/100,# for beta regression
                    pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,]), # for other modeling
                    weights = as.numeric(weights[subset_,])
  )
  
  if (sum(data$pctParent) == 0) {
    zeroCounts = c(zeroCounts, subset_)
    next
  }
  
  data = merge(data, design, by = "sampleName")
  
  fit = glm(pctParent ~ studyGroup*timePoint*compartment, data = data, weights = data$weights)
  
  models[[subset_]] = fit
}
# close the progress bar
close(pb)
```


```{r generate contrasts for the models}
stats = c()
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(pctParent), style = 3)
i = 0
for (subset_ in names(models)) {
  i = i + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  
  contrasts = contrast::contrast(models[[subset_]], 
                                 list(studyGroup = "DS", timePoint = c("T1", "T2", "T3"), compartment = c("all_Bcells", "antigen_specific")),
                                 list(studyGroup = "TC", timePoint = c("T1", "T2", "T3"), compartment = c("all_Bcells", "antigen_specific"))
  )
  FC = as.numeric(contrasts$foldChange)
  pval = contrasts$Pvalue
  
  contrasts_names = paste0(contrasts$compartment, "_", contrasts$timePoint, "_DS_vs_TC")
  
  stats_ = data.frame(subset = subset_,
                      contrast = contrasts_names,
                      FC = FC,
                      pValue = pval
                     )
  
  stats = rbind(stats, stats_)
}
# close the progress bar
close(pb)


```


```{r run multiple test correction and add level 1 results}
level1Results = c()

# for each unique contrast run multiple test correction on the p-values
for (contrast_ in unique(stats$contrast)) {
  stats_ = dplyr::filter(stats, contrast == contrast_)
  pvals = stats_$pValue
  pvals_corrected = p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
  stats$fdr[stats$contrast == contrast_] = pvals_corrected
  
  level1Results_ = dplyr::filter(stats, contrast == contrast_, subset %in% dplyr::filter(cellSubsets, depth == 1)$subset )
  level1Results_$fdr = p.adjust(level1Results_$pValue, method = "BH")
  level1Results = rbind(level1Results, level1Results_)
  
}
```

```{r level 1 heatmaps}
## level1 heatmaps --------------------------------

for (contrast_ in unique(level1Results$contrast)) {
  contrast_
  study_group = strsplit(contrast_, "_")[[1]][4]
  ref_group = strsplit(contrast_, "_")[[1]][6]
  
  
  time_point = strsplit(contrast_, "_")[[1]][3]
  compartment_ = paste0(strsplit(contrast_, "_")[[1]][c(1,2)], collapse = "_")
  compartment_name = paste0(strsplit(contrast_, "_")[[1]][c(1,2)], collapse = " ")
  
  top.table = dplyr::filter(level1Results, contrast == contrast_, fdr <= 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(FC)))
  
  if (nrow(top.table) == 0) {
    next
  }
  
  top.table$logFC = log2(top.table$FC)
  
  design_ = dplyr::filter(design, studyGroup %in% c(study_group, ref_group), 
                          timePoint == time_point,
                          compartment == compartment_)
  
  reorder = order(design_$studyGroup, design_$ageAtDraw, design_$sex)
  design_ = design_[reorder, ]

  
  pctParent_ = pctParent[match(top.table$subset, rownames(pctParent)), 
                         match(design_$sampleName, colnames(pctParent))]
  
  
  labels = row.names(pctParent_)
  
  tp = t(scale(t(pctParent_)))
  
  ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = list(patientType = design_$patientType,
                                    timePoint = design_$timePoint,
                                    compartment = design_$compartment,
                                    sex = design_$sex,
                                    age = design_$ageAtDraw), 
                          col = list(patientType = colors$studyGroup,
                                     timePoint = colors$timePoint,
                                     compartment = colors$compartment,
                                     sex = colors$sex,
                                     age = colors$ageAtDraw)
  )
  
  showRowNames = length(labels) < 20
  
  hm = Heatmap(tp, 
               show_column_names = FALSE, 
               show_row_names = TRUE, 
               cluster_columns = FALSE, 
               name = "z scaled pct parent", # legend 
               top_annotation = ha, 
               col = colors$heatmap, 
               cluster_rows = TRUE, 
               column_title = paste0("significant level 1 populations from  ", study_group, " vs ", ref_group, " at ", time_point, " in " , compartment_name), # title
               show_row_dend = FALSE,
               na_col = "grey")
  
  # plot(hm)
  
  png(file.path("plots/Bcells/", paste0("hm_level1_", contrast_, ".png")), height= 6, width = 9, units = "in", res = 300)
  print(hm)
  invisible(dev.off())
  
}
```

```{r boxplots for IgG+ and IgD+}
data = pctParent[match(unique(level1Results$subset), rownames(pctParent)), ]

# convert data to long format, use column names as sample names, and row names as subset names

data$subset = rownames(data)

data = merge(data, design, by = "sampleName")

# predict the values using the correct model by using subset column to pull from the models list
data$predicted = NA
for (subset_ in unique(data$subset)) {
  data$predicted[data$subset == subset_] = predict(models[[subset_]], newdata = data[data$subset == subset_, ], type = "response")
}

data$weights = NA

# get the weights for each row from the weights matrix (rows are subset and columns are sampleName)
for (subset_ in unique(data$subset)) {
  data$weights[data$subset == subset_] = unlist(weights[subset_, match(data$sampleName[data$subset == subset_], colnames(weights))])
}

hist(data$weights)


# add the stats for adding signficance symbols
stats_ = level1Results
# grep the time point from the contrast column
stats_$timePoint = gsub(".*_(T[0-9])_.*", "\\1", stats_$contrast)
# add the compartment
stats_$compartment = if_else(str_detect(stats_$contrast, "all"), "all_Bcells", "antigen_specific")
stats_$label = if_else(stats_$fdr < 0.005, "**", if_else(stats_$fdr < 0.05, "*", ""))
stats_ = dplyr::filter(stats_, label != "")

# summarize data, calculate the median for each subset, timepoint compartment and study group
data_summary = data %>%
  dplyr::filter(weights > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subset, timePoint, compartment, studyGroup) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(group_median_pct_parent = median(pctParent))

stats_$group_1_median_pct_parent = stats_$group_2_median_pct_parent = NA
for (i in 1:nrow(stats_)) {
  stats_$group_1_median_pct_parent[i] = data_summary$group_median_pct_parent[data_summary$subset == stats_$subset[i] & 
                                                                          data_summary$timePoint == stats_$timePoint[i] & 
                                                                          data_summary$compartment == stats_$compartment[i] & 
                                                                          data_summary$studyGroup == "DS"]
  stats_$group_2_median_pct_parent[i] = data_summary$group_median_pct_parent[data_summary$subset == stats_$subset[i] & 
                                                                          data_summary$timePoint == stats_$timePoint[i] & 
                                                                          data_summary$compartment == stats_$compartment[i] & 
                                                                          data_summary$studyGroup == "TC"]
}


stats_$signif_position = stats_$group_1_median_pct_parent + stats_$group_1_median_pct_parent / 2 + 20
# stats_$signif_position = if_else(stats_$signif_position > 100, 100, stats_$signif_position)
stats_$signif_position = 105
stats_$signif_symbol = 110
stats_$studyGroup = NA

bar_width <- 0.2

# this is needed to convert the time points to numeric for ggplot for plotting it all in the same plot
data$timePoint = as.numeric(gsub("T", "", data$timePoint))
stats_$timePoint = as.numeric(gsub("T", "", stats_$timePoint))

timepoint_labels = c("T1", "T2", "T3")

ggplot(dplyr::filter(data, weights>0), 
       aes(x = as.factor(timePoint), y = pctParent, fill = studyGroup)) + 
  theme_bw() +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(shape = 21, size = 1, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75)) +
  # geom_jitter(aes(size = weights), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 1)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = predicted), size = 1, shape = 15, color = "darkred", position=position_dodge(width=0.75)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
  facet_grid(subset~compartment) +
  labs(x = "Time point", y = "Percent parent", title = "All level 1 subsets with predictors", size = "log10(weights)") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")  +
  geom_text(data = stats_, aes(x = timePoint, y = signif_symbol, label = label), size = 3, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(data = stats_, aes(x = timePoint - bar_width,
                                  xend = timePoint + bar_width, y = signif_position, yend = signif_position), size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.05, 0.2)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = timepoint_labels)
  

ggsave(file = "plots/Bcells/boxplot_level1.png", width = 8, height = 30, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

# Modifier analysis
```{r extend stats structure}
# since the contrasts are all about time points and compartments, I am going to add that information here to make my life easier later
stats$compartment = if_else(str_detect(stats$contrast, "all"), "all_Bcells", "antigen_specific")
# extract time point by maching TX where x is a digit
stats$timePoint = gsub(".*_(T[0-9])_.*", "\\1", stats$contrast)
stats$control_group = "TC"
stats$study_group = "DS"
stats$depth = str_count(stats$subset, "/") + 1

stats = merge(stats, dplyr::select(cellSubsets, subset, leafNode, modifier1, modifier2), by = "subset")

# I also noticed that we have a bunch of cell subsets that are not in the stats - this happens when across ALL samples, the counts are 0
symdiff(cellSubsets$subset, stats$subset)
# this is probably a good opportunity to clean up the cellSubsets structure
# we should also add additional information (like median counts and sd of counts) to the stats structure
```


```{r expand on the stats}
contrasts = distinct(dplyr::select(stats, contrast, compartment, timePoint, control_group, study_group))


# save(stats, file = "results/Bcells_stats.RData")
load(file = "results/Bcells_stats.RData")
# loop over the contrasts and print out the contrast
summary_stats = c()
for (iContrast in 1:nrow(contrasts)) {
  contrast_ = contrasts$contrast[iContrast]
  compartment_ = contrasts$compartment[iContrast]
  timePoint_ = contrasts$timePoint[iContrast]
  control_group_ = contrasts$control_group[iContrast]
  study_group_ = contrasts$study_group[iContrast]
  
  stats_ = stats %>% 
    dplyr::filter(contrast == contrast_) %>%
    dplyr::select(contrast, subset)
  
  control_samples = dplyr::filter(design, studyGroup == control_group_, timePoint == timePoint_, compartment == compartment_)$sampleName
  study_samples = dplyr::filter(design, studyGroup == study_group_, timePoint == timePoint_, compartment == compartment_)$sampleName
  
  
  counts_control = counts[stats_$subset, control_samples]
  counts_study = counts[stats_$subset , study_samples]
  pctParent_control = pctParent[stats_$subset, control_samples]
  pctParent_study = pctParent[stats_$subset, study_samples]

  weights_control = weights[stats_$subset, control_samples]
  weights_study = weights[stats_$subset, study_samples]
  
  # calculate the median and sd of the counts
  # we have to make sure that we do this based on only the samples that had a 
  # nonzero count in the parent population (which is what we use the weights for)
  for (iSubset in 1:nrow(stats_) ) {
    controls_idx = weights_control[iSubset, ] > 0
    study_idx = weights_study[iSubset, ] > 0
    
    counts_control_subset = as.numeric(counts_control[iSubset, controls_idx])
    counts_study_subset = as.numeric(counts_study[iSubset, study_idx])
    
    pctParent_control_subset = as.numeric(pctParent_control[iSubset, controls_idx])
    pctParent_study_subset = as.numeric(pctParent_study[iSubset, study_idx])
    
    stats_$medianCountsControl[iSubset] = median(counts_control_subset)
    stats_$meanCountsControl[iSubset] =   mean(counts_control_subset)
    stats_$sdCountsControl[iSubset] =     sd(counts_control_subset)
    stats_$medianCountsStudy[iSubset] =   median(counts_study_subset)
    stats_$meanCountsStudy[iSubset] =     mean(counts_study_subset)
    stats_$sdCountsStudy[iSubset] =       sd(counts_study_subset)
  
    stats_$medianPctParentControl[iSubset] = median(pctParent_control_subset)
    stats_$meanPctParentControl[iSubset] =   mean(pctParent_control_subset)
    stats_$sdPctParentControl[iSubset] =     sd(pctParent_control_subset)
    stats_$medianPctParentStudy[iSubset] =   median(pctParent_study_subset)
    stats_$meanPctParentControl[iSubset] =   median(pctParent_study_subset)
    stats_$sdPctParentStudy[iSubset] =       sd(pctParent_study_subset)
    
  }

  #merge into stats
  summary_stats = rbind(summary_stats, stats_)
}

stats = merge(stats, summary_stats, by = c("contrast", "subset"))

```


```{r modifier analysis}
# modifierAnalysis = function(fullstats, counts, p_cutoff = 0.05, ref_group = verbose = T) {

pCutoff = 0.05

full_report = c()
removed_from_report = c()
modifierComparisons = c()

  for (iContrast in 1:nrow(contrasts)) {
    
    contrast_ = contrasts$contrast[iContrast]
    timePoint_ = contrasts$timePoint[iContrast]
    compartment_ = contrasts$compartment[iContrast]
    control_group_ = contrasts$control_group[iContrast]
    study_group_ = contrasts$study_group[iContrast]
    
    if (verbose) message(paste0("Starting modifier analysis of ", control_group_, " vs ", study_group_, " for compartment ", compartment_, " at time point ", timePoint_, "."))

    stats_ = dplyr::filter(stats, 
                           contrast == contrast_, 
                           (medianCountsControl > 10 |  medianCountsStudy > 10))
    
    # background correct counts
    control_samples = dplyr::filter(design, studyGroup == control_group_, timePoint == timePoint_, compartment == compartment_)$sampleName
  study_samples = dplyr::filter(design, studyGroup == study_group_, timePoint == timePoint_, compartment == compartment_)$sampleName
    
    pctParent_control = pctParent[stats_$subset, control_samples]
    pctParent_study = pctParent[stats_$subset , study_samples]
  
    # subtract the median count from stats_$medianCountsControl from the counts
    # pctParent_control_corrected = pctParent_control - stats_$medianPctParentControl # don't need the control group since we are correcting by the median of the controls
    pctParent_study_corrected = pctParent_study - stats_$medianPctParentControl
    
    weights_control = weights[stats_$subset, control_samples]
    weights_study = weights[stats_$subset, study_samples]
    
    
    report = c()

    max_depth = max(stats_$depth)

    # Find all the nodes that we have
    # First remove + and -, find uniques, and then read +/- in regexp compatible form
    nodes = stats_$subset
    nodes = paste(nodes, collapse = "/")
    # nodes = str_remove_all(nodes, "\\+|\\-")
    nodes = str_split(nodes, "/", simplify = T)
    nodes = nodes[nodes != ""]
    nodes = unique(nodes)
    # nodes = c(paste0(nodes, "\\+"), paste0(nodes, "\\-"))

    # Add a column modifier_path by removing the root node and also removing the terminal node
    stats_$modifier_path = sub("/[^/]*$", "", stats_$subset)
    stats_$modifier_path[stats_$depth == 1] = ""

    # Build a binary mask for all modifier paths
    modifier_masks = lapply(stats_$modifier_path, function(x) { ifelse(str_detect(x, nodes), "1", "0") })
    for (i in 1:length(modifier_masks)) {
      stats_$modifier_mask[i] = unlist(paste0(modifier_masks[[i]], collapse = ""))
    }

    subpopulations = list()
    for (depth_ in max_depth:1) {
      subpopulations[[depth_]] = dplyr::filter(stats_, depth == depth_, pValue < pCutoff)
    }

    for (depth_ in max_depth:1) {
      nPops = nrow(subpopulations[[depth_]])

      if (verbose) message(paste0("Modifier analysis of ", nPops, " subpopulations with fdr corrected p-value < ", pCutoff, " at gating depth ", depth_, "."))
      iPop = 0

      if (nPops == 0) {next}

      if (verbose) pb = txtProgressBar(min = iPop, max = nPops, style = 3)

      for (iPop in 1:nPops) {
        if (verbose) setTxtProgressBar(pb, iPop)

        population_ = subpopulations[[depth_]][iPop, ]

        # Turn all the modifiers into a vector
        modifier_vec = unlist(strsplit(str_remove(population_$modifier_path, '^/'), "/"))

        if (depth_ == 1) {
          population_$modifierAnalysisAgainst = "no parents"
          population_$modifierAnalysisPvalue = NA
          report = rbind(report, population_)
          next
        }

        nmodifier_ = depth_-1

        # Calculate the combinations of the modifiers
        if (nmodifier_ == 1) {
          combinations = matrix("", ncol = 1)
        } else {
          combinations = combn(modifier_vec, m = nmodifier_-1)
        }

        background_corrected_x = as.numeric(pctParent_study_corrected[population_$subset, weights_study[population_$subset, ] > 0] )

        case_counter = matrix(0,
                              nrow = 2, ncol = 2,
                              dimnames = list(c("non_significant_FDR_in_parent", "significant_FDR_in_parent"),
                                              c("no_significance_between_node_and_parent", "significance_between_node_and_parent")
                              ))
        parents = c()
        for (iCombination in 1:ncol(combinations)) {
          combination_mask = paste0(ifelse(str_detect(paste0(combinations[ , iCombination], collapse = "."), nodes), "1", "0"), collapse = "")
          parent_ = dplyr::filter(stats_, modifier_mask == combination_mask, leafNode == population_$leafNode)

          if (nrow(parent_) == 0) {next}

          

          background_corrected_y = as.numeric(pctParent_study_corrected[parent_$subset, weights_study[parent_$subset, ] > 0] )
          
          if (F) {
          # diagnostics plots
          data = data.frame(pctParent = background_corrected_x, node = "leaf", subset = population_$subset, type = "corrected", studyGroup = "exp") %>%
            rbind(data.frame(pctParent = background_corrected_y, node = "parent", subset = parent_$subset, type = "corrected", studyGroup = "exp")) %>%
            rbind(data.frame(pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent_study[parent_$subset, ]), node = "parent", subset = parent_$subset, type = "raw", studyGroup = "exp")) %>%
            rbind(data.frame(pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent_study[population_$subset, ]), node = "leaf", subset = population_$subset, type = "raw", studyGroup = "exp")) %>%  
            rbind(data.frame(pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent_control[parent_$subset, ]), node = "parent", subset = parent_$subset, type = "raw", studyGroup = "ref")) %>%
            rbind(data.frame(pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent_control[population_$subset, ]), node = "leaf", subset = population_$subset, type = "raw", studyGroup = "ref"))
          
          diagnosticplot = ggplot(data, aes(x = node, y = pctParent, color = studyGroup)) +
            geom_boxplot() +
            facet_wrap(~type) +
            geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75)) +
            labs(title = paste0("Node: ", population_$subset, " vs Parent: ", parent_$subset, "\nEach distribution is centered correct by median of ref group (0)"))
          
          ggsave(diagnosticplot, file = paste0("plots/Bcells/modifierAnalysis/", contrast_,  "/", str_replace_all(population_$subset, "/", "-"), "_vs_", str_replace_all(parent_$subset, "/", "-"), ".png"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
          }
          
          p_value_node_vs_parent = wilcox.test(background_corrected_x, background_corrected_y, exact = FALSE)$p.value
          
          parent_$modifierAnalysisAgainst = population_$subset
          parent_$modifierAnalysisPvalue = p_value_node_vs_parent
          
          # if R/A/B/C is investigated
          # if there is a significant difference between R/A/C and R/A/B/C
          if (p_value_node_vs_parent < pCutoff) {
            # R/A/C vs R/A/B/C IS significant
            col = "significance_between_node_and_parent"
          } else {
            col = "no_significance_between_node_and_parent"
          }

          # if (parent_$pValue < pCutoff) {
          if (parent_$fdr < pCutoff) { # should we make this comparison by FDR or raw pvalue
            # If R/A/C by itself is significant
            row = "significant_FDR_in_parent"
          } else {
            row = "non_significant_FDR_in_parent"
          }

          case_counter[row, col] =+ 1
          
          parents = rbind(parents, parent_)

        }
        
        
        if (nrow(parents) > 0) {
          population_$modifierAnalysisAgainst = paste0(parents$subset, collapse = ",")
          population_$modifierAnalysisPvalue = paste0(signif(parents$modifierAnalysisPvalue, 3), collapse = ",")
          
          modifierComparisons_ = parents %>% 
            dplyr::select(parent = subset, contrast = contrast, child = modifierAnalysisAgainst, pValueModifierAnalysis = modifierAnalysisPvalue, logFCParent = FC, fdrParent = fdr) %>% 
            dplyr::mutate(
              logFCParent = log2(logFCParent),
              logFCChild = log2(population_$FC),
              fdrChild = population_$fdr)
          
          modifierComparisons = rbind(modifierComparisons, modifierComparisons_)
        } else {
          population_$modifierAnalysisAgainst = "no significant parents"
          population_$modifierAnalysisPvalue = NA
          
          modifierComparisons_ = data.frame(parent = "no significant parents", child = population_$subset, pValueModifierAnalysis = NA, logFCParent = NA, fdrParent = NA, logFCChild = log2(population_$FC), fdrChild = population_$fdr)
          
          modifierComparisons = rbind(modifierComparisons, modifierComparisons_)
        }
        

        if (sum(case_counter["significant_FDR_in_parent", ]) == 1 &
            case_counter["significant_FDR_in_parent", "no_significance_between_node_and_parent"] == 1 ) {
          # This is the case where one parent has a significant FDR, and the select subpopulation compared to that parent has no significant difference
          # In this case, we can assume that the observed difference in the node is driven by the parent.
          # We need to make sure that a) there is ONLY ONE parent that is significant and b) that this parent shows no difference in the distribution of values between itself and the subpopulation
          
          # We only want to report the parent, and remove the node from the report (in case it has been added previously by a deeper gating depth)

          if (!is.null(report)) {
            report = dplyr::filter(report, subset != population_$subset)
          }
          # The parent is getting reported outside the if condition

          # For debugging reasons, I am also keeping track of subpopulations that get removed
          removed_from_report = rbind(removed_from_report, population_)
        } else {
          report = rbind(report, population_)
        }

        # report all parents that have a significant FDR (if there are parents at all)
        if (!is.null(parents)) {
          report = rbind(report, dplyr::filter(parents, fdr < pCutoff) )
        }

      }
      if (verbose) close(pb)
    }

    # if (is.null(report)) {
    #   return(NULL)
    # }

    report = dplyr::select(report, -modifier_mask, -modifier_path)
    report = distinct(report)

    full_report = rbind(full_report, report)

    if (!is.null(removed_from_report)) {
      removed_from_report = distinct(removed_from_report)
    }

  }
  # return(full_report)

modifierResults = full_report
```

### Heatmaps
```{r modifier results heatmaps}
for (contrast_ in unique(modifierResults$contrast)) {
  contrast_
  top.table = dplyr::filter(modifierResults, contrast == contrast_, fdr <= 0.05)
  
  if (nrow(top.table) == 0) {
    next
    }
  
  study_group = top.table$study_group[1]
  ref_group =  top.table$control_group[1]
  
  
  time_point = top.table$timePoint[1]
  compartment_ = top.table$compartment[1]
  compartment_name = str_replace(compartment_, "_", " ")
  
  top.table = dplyr::select(top.table, subset, FC, pValue, fdr) %>%
    distinct()
  
  top.table$logFC = log2(top.table$FC)
  
  design_ = dplyr::filter(design, studyGroup %in% c(study_group, ref_group), 
                          timePoint == time_point,
                          compartment == compartment_)
  
  reorder = order(design_$studyGroup, design_$ageAtDraw, design_$sex)
  design_ = design_[reorder, ]

  
  pctParent_ = pctParent[match(top.table$subset, rownames(pctParent)), 
                         match(design_$sampleName, colnames(pctParent))]
  
  
  labels = row.names(pctParent_)
  
  tp = t(scale(t(pctParent_)))
  
  ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = list(patientType = design_$patientType,
                                    timePoint = design_$timePoint,
                                    compartment = design_$compartment,
                                    sex = design_$sex,
                                    age = design_$ageAtDraw), 
                          col = list(patientType = colors$studyGroup,
                                     timePoint = colors$timePoint,
                                     compartment = colors$compartment,
                                     sex = colors$sex,
                                     age = colors$ageAtDraw)
  )
  
  showRowNames = length(labels) < 30
  
  hm = Heatmap(tp, 
               show_column_names = FALSE, 
               show_row_names = showRowNames, 
               cluster_columns = FALSE, 
               name = "z scaled pct parent", # legend 
               top_annotation = ha, 
               col = colors$heatmap, 
               cluster_rows = TRUE, 
               column_title = paste0("modifier results from  ", study_group, " vs ", ref_group, " at ", time_point, " in " , compartment_name), # title
               show_row_dend = FALSE,
               na_col = "grey")
  
  # plot(hm)
  
  png(file.path("plots/Bcells/", paste0("hm_modifier_results_", contrast_, ".png")), height= 6, width = 9, units = "in", res = 300)
  print(hm)
  invisible(dev.off())
  
}
```

```{r keep digging}
# Since there is such a weak age dependence, let's see if there is a sex dependent effect while averaging over age
# emm <- emmeans(fit,  ~sex | studyGroup * timePoint, cov.reduce = mean, reverse = TRUE)
emm <- emmeans(fit,  studyGroup * timePoint, cov.reduce = mean, reverse = TRUE)

summary(emm)

# lets compare this to an actual model that does not contain age
fit_no_age = glm(log10(RBDperMil) ~ studyGroup*timePoint*sex, data = data)
summary(fit_no_age)
emm_no_age <- emmeans(fit_no_age, ~ studyGroup * timePoint *sex, cov.reduce = mean, reverse = TRUE)
summary(emm_no_age, infer = TRUE)            
emm_tests <- test(emm_no_age)              
summary(emm_tests)
# this gives suspiciously small pvalues - let's go dig into this

plot(fit_no_age)
   
# but if I run joint_tests, I get somewhat okay looking pvalues:
joint_tests(fit_no_age, by = c("timePoint", "studyGroup"))

contrast(emm, interaction = "pairwise", by = c("timePoint", "studyGroup"), reverse = TRUE)
# so, to some up, joint_tests and contrasts is going to give me the same "information", but contrasts also gives the estimate of the difference - which I guess must be the log10 fold change
contrast(emm_no_age, interaction = "pairwise", by = c("timePoint", "studyGroup"), reverse = TRUE)
 
 # so it seems that this estimate is the log10 fold change
  # If I was modeling in logscale, I get back the logfold change. If I was modeling on the original scale, I get the fold change.

# and the contrasts for emm_no_age are pretty much identical to joint_tests, but I also get the fold change and don't need to calculate it.

# enough exploratory work, let's answer some of bernards questions!
```                 

```{r answer a first question}
# How does number of Ag-specific B cell differ TC vs DS @ T2? T3? - box plots and line plots that we have made above
```

# Model gene counts with our big model
```{r run the full analysis using the big model}
models = list()
#initialize a progress bar
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(pctParent), style = 3)
i = 0

zeroCounts = c()
# instead of checking this here, we should probably count the pct parents and parent and actual counts, add them as columns to the cellSubsets data frame and then loop over that

# Define a function to fit the models
fit_model <- function(data) {
  # Attempt to fit the lmer model
  fit <- tryCatch({
    lmer(pctParent ~ studyGroup * timePoint * compartment * sex * ageAtDraw + (1 | khorLabId), 
         data = data, weights = data$weights)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If lmer fails, fit the glm model
    glm(pctParent ~ studyGroup * timePoint * compartment * sex * ageAtDraw, 
        data = data, weights = data$weights)
  })
  
  return(fit)
}

for (subset_ in row.names(pctParent)) {
  # update the progress bar
  i = i + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  
  data = data.frame(sampleName = colnames(pctParent),
                    # pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,])/100,# for beta regression
                    pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,]), # for other modeling
                    weights = as.numeric(weights[subset_,])
  )
  
  if (sum(data$pctParent) == 0) {
    zeroCounts = c(zeroCounts, subset_)
    next
  }
  
  data = merge(data, design, by = "sampleName")
  
  # I initially used a boring glm
  fit = glm(pctParent ~ studyGroup*timePoint*compartment*sex*ageAtDraw, data = data, weights = data$weights)
  # Then I started using a mixed model that includes the donor as a random effect
 
  # fit = lmer(pctParent ~ studyGroup*timePoint*compartment*sex*ageAtDraw  + (1 | khorLabId), data = data, weights = data$weights)
  # fit <- fit_model(data)

  models[[subset_]] = fit
}
# close the progress bar
close(pb)
```

### Make the figures
```{r make the figures}
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(models), style = 3)
i = 0

for (subset_ in names(models)) {
  i = i + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  
  age_trends <- emtrends(models[[subset_]], ~ studyGroup * timePoint * compartment, var = "ageAtDraw")
  age_trends = test(age_trends)
  # can compare to join_tests and you will notice that the pvalues between the above test and in join_tests are the same for "ageAtDraw
  # joint_tests(models[[subset_]], by = c("timePoint", "studyGroup", "compartment"))

  age_trends$contrasts_names = paste0(age_trends$compartment, "_", age_trends$timePoint, "_", age_trends$studyGroup)
  
  # Diagnostic plots to make sure what we get makes sense ------------------------------------------------------
  # Maybe should remake these plots with fdrs?
  # Get the experimental data
  data = data.frame(sampleName = colnames(pctParent),
                    pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,]), # for other modeling
                    weights = as.numeric(weights[subset_,])
  ) %>% dplyr::filter(weights > 0)
  
  data = merge(data, design, by = "sampleName")
  
  # Get the predictions using emmeans and averaging over sex
  emm <- emmeans(models[[subset_]], ~ studyGroup * timePoint * compartment * ageAtDraw,
               by = c("studyGroup", "timePoint", "compartment"),
               at = list(ageAtDraw = seq(min(data$ageAtDraw), max(data$ageAtDraw), length.out = 100) ),
               cov.reduce = mean)
  
  predictions <- as.data.frame(emm)
  
  predictions <- predictions %>%
    rename(fit = emmean) %>%
    mutate(lower.CL = fit - 1.96 * SE,
           upper.CL = fit + 1.96 * SE)
  
  
  # Prep the pvalues to be plotted
  stats_ = dplyr::filter(statsAge, subset == subset_)
  stats_$ageAtDraw = mean(data$ageAtDraw)
  stats_$position[stats_$studyGroup == "TC"] = 80
  stats_$position[stats_$studyGroup == "DS"] = 60
  stats_$label = paste0("padj(", stats_$studyGroup, ") = ", signif(stats_$fdr, 3))
  
  # Plot the data and the predictions
  fig = ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = data, aes(color = studyGroup, shape = sex, x = ageAtDraw, y = pctParent), size = 2) +
    # geom_jitter(aes(color = patientType), size = 2, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Age at Draw", y = "Percent Parent", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age dependence of ", subset_) ) +
    # log scale
    facet_grid(compartment~timePoint)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = ageAtDraw, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = ageAtDraw, y = fit, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4) +
    geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(stats_, fdr < 0.1), aes(x = ageAtDraw, y = position, label = label), size = 2, vjust = 0.5) +
    ylim(-5, 100)

  ggsave(file = paste0("plots/Bcells/ageEffects/", str_remove_all(subset_, "/"), ".png"), fig, width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)

}
# close the progress bar
close(pb)

```

## At T1, which Bcells features change with age in TC?

```{r find the features that differ}
T1_Bcell_age_effects = dplyr::filter(statsAge, 
                                     timePoint == "T1", 
                                     compartment == "all_Bcells", 
                                     studyGroup == "TC",
                                     fdr < 0.1)

design_ = dplyr::filter(design, 
                       timePoint == "T1", 
                       compartment == "all_Bcells", 
                       # studyGroup == "TC"
                       )

# Now, we want to model the ageAtDraw for these subsets

T1_age_tests_DS_vs_TC = c()

pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(cellSubsets$subset), style = 3)
i = 0

for (subset_ in T1_Bcell_age_effects$subset) {
# for (subset_ in cellSubsets$subset) {
  i = i + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  # update the progress bar
  
  # if (file.exists(paste0("plots/Bcells/agePredictions_T1/", str_remove_all(subset_, "/"), ".png"))) {
  #   next
  # }
  
  data_ = data.frame(sampleName = colnames(pctParent),
                    # pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,])/100,# for beta regression
                    pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,]), # for other modeling
                    weights = as.numeric(weights[subset_,])
  )
  
  
  data_ = dplyr::filter(data_, sampleName %in% design_$sampleName)
  
  data_ = merge(data_, design, by = "sampleName")
  
  if (sum(data_$weights[data_$studyGroup == "TC"] == 0)) {
    print("what is going on here?")
    next
  }
  
  if ( length( unique(data_$pctParent[data_$studyGroup == "TC"]) ) == 1 ) {
    print("what is going on here, but two?")
    next
  }
  
  # I initially used a boring glm
  # fit <- gam(ageAtDraw ~ s(pctParent), data = data_[data_$studyGroup == "TC", ], weights = data_$weights[data_$studyGroup == "TC"])

  fit = glm(ageAtDraw ~ pctParent, data = data_[data_$studyGroup == "TC", ], weights = data_$weights[data_$studyGroup == "TC"])

  
  # predict ageAtDraw using pctParent in data_ and evaluate the residuals

  data_$predictedAge = predict(fit, newdata = data_)
  data_$delta =  data_$predictedAge - data_$ageAtDraw
  
  residuals_summary <- summary(data_$delta[data_$studyGroup == "DS"])
  # print(residuals_summary)

  rmse <- sqrt(mean(data_$delta[data_$studyGroup == "DS"]^2))
  # print(paste("RMSE:", rmse))
  
    # Step 4: Perform a paired t-test
  t_test_result <- t.test(data_$predictedAge[data_$studyGroup == "DS"], data_$ageAtDraw[data_$studyGroup == "DS"], paired = TRUE)
  
  # Print t-test results
  print(t_test_result)
  
  # Extract and print the p-value
  p_value <- t_test_result$p.value
  print(paste("p-value:", p_value))
  
  T1_age_tests_DS_vs_TC = rbind(T1_age_tests_DS_vs_TC, data.frame(subset = subset_, 
                                                                  pValue = p_value, 
                                                                  meanAgeDifference = mean(data_$delta[data_$studyGroup == "DS"]) )
                                )
  
  # Get the line and confidence interval
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ pctParent,
               at = list(pctParent = seq(min(data_$pctParent), max(data_$pctParent), length.out = 50))
  )
  
  predictions <- as.data.frame(emm)
  
  predictions <- predictions %>%
    rename(fit = emmean) %>%
    mutate(lower.CL = fit - 1.96 * SE,
           upper.CL = fit + 1.96 * SE)
  predictions$studyGroup = "TC"
  
  figs = list()
  # Overview figure 1, look if there is in age effect
  figs[[1]] = ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = ageAtDraw, y = pctParent), size = 2) +
    # geom_jitter(aes(color = patientType), size = 2, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Age at Draw", y = "Percent parent", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age dependence of ", subset_) ) + 
    # scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    ylim(0, 100)
  
  # Overview two, plot predicted age by percent parent
  figs[[2]] = ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = pctParent, y = ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Percent parent", y = "Age at draw", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age prediction based on pct parent for ", subset_) ) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, y = fit, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4)
  
  # Overview three, center around predicted age
  figs[[3]] =  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = pctParent, y = predictedAge-ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Percent parent", y = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Difference between actual and predicted age for ", subset_) ) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, ymin = lower.CL-fit, ymax = upper.CL-fit, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, y = 0, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4)
    
    # Plot 4, histogram of the delta
  figs[[4]] = ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = data_, aes(x = delta, fill = studyGroup), bins = 30) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", y = "Count", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Histogram of age difference for ", subset_) ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
    
    
    # Plot 5 density of the delta
  figs[[5]] = ggplot(data = data_, aes(x = delta, fill = studyGroup)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", y = "Density", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Density plot of age difference for ", subset_) ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
  
  # put all figs from list into a single plot
  fig = ggarrange(plotlist = figs, ncol = 1)
  # fig
  
  ggsave(file = paste0("plots/Bcells/aging/T1_all_Bcells/", str_remove_all(subset_, "/"), ".png"), fig, width = 8, height =20, units = "in", dpi = 300)
}
```

## Are Ag-specific B cells enriched in age-associated features compared to global B cells in TC vs DS? Are the differences in the ag specific also in the global B cell 

```{r find differing age effects in globas vs ag specific compartment}

global_vs_ag_age_contrasts = c()

pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(models), style = 3)
i = 0

for (subset_ in names(models)) {
  i = i + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  
  emm = emtrends(models[[subset_]], ~ studyGroup * timePoint * compartment, var = "ageAtDraw")
  
  pairwise_contrasts <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", by = c("timePoint", "studyGroup"))
  
  contrast_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(pairwise_contrasts))
  contrast_summary$subset = subset_
  
  global_vs_ag_age_contrasts = rbind(global_vs_ag_age_contrasts, contrast_summary)
  
}

close(pb)

global_vs_ag_age_contrasts$fdr = p.adjust(global_vs_ag_age_contrasts$p.value, method = "BH")
global_vs_ag_age_contrasts = merge(global_vs_ag_age_contrasts, cellSubsets, by = "subset")
```

```{r correct for multiple testing and write to file}
                  depth, leafNode, modifier1, modifier2) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(fdr)

  sheetName_ = str_replace(contrast_, "all_Bcells", "global")
  # Write results to Excel file
  addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = sheetName_)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheetName_, x = top.table)
  
}
```

```{r find the features that differ at T2 or T3}
    # print(residuals_summary)
  
    rmse <- sqrt(mean(data_$delta[data_$studyGroup == "DS"]^2))
    # print(paste("RMSE:", rmse))
    
      # Step 4: Perform a paired t-test
    t_test_result <- t.test(data_$predictedAge[data_$studyGroup == "DS"], data_$ageAtDraw[data_$studyGroup == "DS"], paired = TRUE)
    
    # Print t-test results
    print(t_test_result)
    
    # Extract and print the p-value
    p_value <- t_test_result$p.value
    print(paste("p-value:", p_value))
    
    T2_T3_age_tests_DS_vs_TC = rbind(T2_T3_age_tests_DS_vs_TC, data.frame(subset = subset_, 
                                                                    pValue = p_value, 
                                                                    meanAgeDifference = mean(data_$delta[data_$studyGroup == "DS"]),
                                                                    timePoint = T_,
                                                                    compartment = compartment_
                                                                    )
                                  )
    
    # Get the line and confidence interval
    emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ pctParent,
                 at = list(pctParent = seq(min(data_$pctParent), max(data_$pctParent), length.out = 50))
    )
    
    predictions <- as.data.frame(emm)
    
    predictions <- predictions %>%
      rename(fit = emmean) %>%
      mutate(lower.CL = fit - 1.96 * SE,
             upper.CL = fit + 1.96 * SE)
    predictions$studyGroup = "TC"
    
    figs = list()
    # Overview figure 1, look if there is in age effect
    figs[[1]] = ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = ageAtDraw, y = pctParent), size = 2) +
      # geom_jitter(aes(color = patientType), size = 2, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75)) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(x = "Age at Draw", y = "Percent parent", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age dependence of ", subset_, ", ", T_, ", ", compartment_) ) + 
      # scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
      ylim(0, 100)
    
    # Overview two, plot predicted age by percent parent
    figs[[2]] = ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = pctParent, y = ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(x = "Percent parent", y = "Age at draw", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age prediction based on pct parent for ", subset_, ", ", T_, ", ", compartment_) ) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
      geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, y = fit, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4)
    
    # Overview three, center around predicted age
    figs[[3]] =  ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = pctParent, y = predictedAge-ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(x = "Percent parent", y = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Difference between actual and predicted age for ", subset_, ", ", T_, ", ", compartment_) ) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
      geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, ymin = lower.CL-fit, ymax = upper.CL-fit, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, y = 0, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4)
      
      # Plot 4, histogram of the delta
    figs[[4]] = ggplot() +
      geom_histogram(data = data_, aes(x = delta, fill = studyGroup), bins = 30) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(x = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", y = "Count", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Histogram of age difference for ", subset_, ", ", T_, ", ", compartment_) ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
      
      
      # Plot 5 density of the delta
    figs[[5]] = ggplot(data = data_, aes(x = delta, fill = studyGroup)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(x = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", y = "Density", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Density plot of age difference for ", subset_, ", ", T_, ", ", compartment_) ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
    
    # put all figs from list into a single plot
    fig = ggarrange(plotlist = figs, ncol = 1)

    ggsave(file = paste0("plots/Bcells/aging/", T_, "_", compartment_, "/", str_remove_all(subset_, "/"), ".png"), fig, width = 8, height =20, units = "in", dpi = 300)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r merge that with the predictions from T1}
  }
```

```{r model it}
modelsDeltas = list()
#initialize a progress bar
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(pctParent), style = 3)
i = 0

timePointCombs = c("T1 - T2", "T2 - T3", "T1 - T3")

for (subset_ in row.names(pctParent)) {
  # update the progress bar
  i = i + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  
  data = data.frame(sampleName = colnames(pctParent),
                    # pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,])/100,# for beta regression
                    pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,]), # for other modeling
                    weights = as.numeric(weights[subset_,])
  )
  
  if (sum(data$pctParent) == 0) {
    zeroCounts = c(zeroCounts, subset_)
    next
  }
  
  data = merge(data, design, by = "sampleName")
  
  deltaData = c()
  for (timePointComb_ in timePointCombs) {
    Ti = str_split(timePointComb_, " - ")[[1]][1]
    Tj = str_split(timePointComb_, " - ")[[1]][2]
    
    datai = data %>% dplyr::filter(timePoint == Ti) 
    dataj = data %>% dplyr::filter(timePoint == Tj) %>% select(khorLabId, compartment, pctParent, weights)
    
    dataij = merge(datai, dataj, by = c("khorLabId", "compartment"), suffixes = c("_i", "_j"))
    dataij = dplyr::filter(dataij, weights_i > 0 & weights_j > 0)
  dataij$timePoint = timePointComb_
  
    dataij = dplyr::select(dataij, khorLabId, timePoint, compartment, studyGroup, patientType, ageAtDraw, sex, race, hispanic, batch, group, pctParent_i, weights_i, pctParent_j, weights_j) # limit the data since a lot no longer apply (sample specific), and we don't want to get confused later
    
    dataij$delta = dataij$pctParent_j - dataij$pctParent_i
    
    deltaData = rbind(deltaData, dataij)
  }
  
  deltaData$weights = pmin(deltaData$weights_i, deltaData$weights_j)

  fit = glm(delta ~ studyGroup*timePoint*compartment, data = deltaData, weights = deltaData$weights)

  modelsDeltas[[subset_]] = fit
}
# close the progress bar
close(pb)
```

```{r make contrasts for the deltas}

                      timePoint = contrasts_deltas_$timePoint,
                      delta = contrasts_deltas_$estimate,
                      SE = contrasts_deltas_$SE,
                      pValue = contrasts_deltas_$p.value
                     )

  statsDeltas = rbind(statsDeltas, stats_)
}
```

```{r export delta modeling contrasts}
  wb <- loadWorkbook(analysisFile)
} else {
  wb <- createWorkbook()
}


for (contrast_ in unique(statsDeltas$contrast)) {
  
  top.table = dplyr::filter(statsDeltas, contrast == contrast_) %>%
    dplyr::select(-contrast) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(fdr)

  # Write results to Excel file
  addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = contrast_)
  writeData(wb, sheet = contrast_, x = top.table)
  
}
saveWorkbook(wb, file = analysisFile, overwrite = TRUE)

```

```{r plot the results from the phenotypic analysis}

xLabels = unique(statsDeltas$timePoint)

prediction_data_grid <- expand.grid(
  timePoint = unique(statsDeltas$timePoint), 
  compartment = unique(statsDeltas$compartment)
)

pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(models), style = 3)
i = 0


# ignoring sex
for (subset_ in names(modelsDeltas)) {
  i = i + 1
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  
  data = data.frame(sampleName = colnames(pctParent),
                      pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,]), # for other modeling
                      weights = as.numeric(weights[subset_,])
    )
  
  data = merge(data, design, by = "sampleName")
  
  deltaData = c()
  for (timePointComb_ in timePointCombs) {
    Ti = str_split(timePointComb_, " - ")[[1]][1]
    Tj = str_split(timePointComb_, " - ")[[1]][2]
    
    datai = data %>% dplyr::filter(timePoint == Ti) 
    dataj = data %>% dplyr::filter(timePoint == Tj) %>% select(khorLabId, compartment, pctParent, weights)
    
    dataij = merge(datai, dataj, by = c("khorLabId", "compartment"), suffixes = c("_i", "_j"))
    dataij = dplyr::filter(dataij, weights_i > 0 & weights_j > 0)
  dataij$timePoint = timePointComb_
  
    dataij = dplyr::select(dataij, khorLabId, timePoint, compartment, studyGroup, patientType, ageAtDraw, sex, race, hispanic, batch, group, pctParent_i, weights_i, pctParent_j, weights_j) # limit the data since a lot no longer apply (sample specific), and we don't want to get confused later
    
    dataij$delta = dataij$pctParent_j - dataij$pctParent_i
    
    deltaData = rbind(deltaData, dataij)
  }
  

  emm = emmeans(modelsDeltas[[subset_]], ~ studyGroup*timePoint*compartment, cov.reduce = mean)
  prediction_data <- merge(prediction_data_grid, emm, by = c("timePoint", "compartment"))

  stats_ = dplyr::filter(statsDeltas, subset == subset_)
  
  stats_$label = if_else(stats_$fdr < 0.005, "**", if_else(stats_$fdr < 0.05, "*", ""))
  # stats_ = dplyr::filter(stats_, label != "")
  stats_$signif_position = 105
  
  # stats_$timePoint = 
  
  stats_$timePointNumeric = as.numeric(stats_$timePoint)
  timepoint_labels = levels(stats_$timePoint)
  
  deltaData$timePoint = factor(deltaData$timePoint, levels = levels(stats_$timePoint))
  deltaData$timePointNumeric = as.numeric(deltaData$timePoint)
  
  prediction_data$timePoint = factor(prediction_data$timePoint, levels = levels(stats_$timePoint))
  prediction_data$timePointNumeric = as.numeric(prediction_data$timePoint)
  
  stats_ = dplyr::filter(stats_, fdr < 0.05)
  
  ggplot(deltaData, aes(x = as.factor(timePointNumeric), color = studyGroup, fill = studyGroup)) + 
    theme_bw() +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = studyGroup, y = delta), color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(fill = studyGroup, y = delta), shape = 21, size = 2, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75)) +
    geom_point(data = prediction_data, 
               aes(x = timePointNumeric, y = emmean, fill = studyGroup), 
               shape = 19, color = "darkred", size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    geom_errorbar(data = prediction_data,
                  aes(x = timePointNumeric, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), 
                  color = "darkred", width = 0.2, linewidth = 1, position=position_dodge(width=0.75)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    facet_grid(~compartment) +
    labs(x = "Ti - Tj", y = "ΔPctParent(Ti-Tj)", title = subset_) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")  +
    geom_text(data = stats_, aes(x = timePointNumeric, y = signif_position+5, label = label), color = "black", size = 10, vjust = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = stats_, aes(x = timePointNumeric - bar_width,
                                    xend = timePointNumeric + bar_width, y = signif_position, yend = signif_position), color = "black", size = 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.05, 0.2)) + 
    scale_x_discrete(labels = timepoint_labels)

  ggsave(file = paste0("plots/Bcells/phenotypic_changes/", str_remove_all(subset_, "/"), ".png"), width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
}
# close the progress bar
close(pb)
```

```{r correlate IgG count T2 with T3}
  labs(x = "#S-specific IgG+ at T2", y = "#S-specific IgG+ at T3", ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
  lims(x = c(0, 60000), y = c(0, 60000))
  # log10 scale
  # scale_x_log10() +
  # scale_y_log10()

```

```{r fit the model}
fit = glm(IgGperMil_T3 ~ IgGperMil_T2*studyGroup, data = data_cor)
AIC(fit)

fit = glm(log10(IgGperMil_T3) ~ log10(IgGperMil_T2)*studyGroup, data = data_cor)
AIC(fit)

fit = glm(log2(IgGperMil_T3) ~ log2(IgGperMil_T2)*studyGroup, data = data_cor)
AIC(fit)

fit = glm(log(IgGperMil_T3) ~ log(IgGperMil_T2)*studyGroup, data = data_cor)
AIC(fit)

# log 10 wins
# data_cor$logIgGperMil_T2 = log10(data_cor$IgGperMil_T2)
# data_cor$logIgGperMil_T3 = log10(data_cor$IgGperMil_T3)
# 
# fit = glm(logIgGperMil_T3 ~ logIgGperMil_T2*studyGroup, data = data_cor)
# AIC(fit)
fit = glm(log10(IgGperMil_T3) ~ log10(IgGperMil_T2)*studyGroup, data = data_cor)
AIC(fit)

fit = glm(IgGperMil_T3 ~ IgGperMil_T2*studyGroup, data = data_cor)
AIC(fit)
```

## Custom heatmap

```{r modifier results heatmaps}

top.table = dplyr::filter(modifierResults, timePoint %in% c("T2", "T3"), compartment == "antigen_specific", fdr <= 0.05)

study_group = top.table$study_group[1]
ref_group =  top.table$control_group[1]

top.table = dplyr::select(top.table, subset) %>%
  distinct()

# top.table$logFC = log2(top.table$FC)

design_ = dplyr::filter(design, 
                        timePoint %in% c("T2", "T3"),
                        compartment == "antigen_specific")

reorder = order(design_$timePoint, design_$studyGroup, design_$ageAtDraw, design_$sex)
design_ = design_[reorder, ]


pctParent_ = pctParent[match(top.table$subset, rownames(pctParent)), 
                       match(design_$sampleName, colnames(pctParent))]


labels = row.names(pctParent_)

tp = t(scale(t(pctParent_)))

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = rev(list(patientType = design_$patientType,
                                  timePoint = design_$timePoint,
                                  compartment = design_$compartment,
                                  sex = design_$sex,
                                  age = design_$ageAtDraw) ), 
                        col = list(patientType = colors$studyGroup,
                                   timePoint = colors$timePoint,
                                   compartment = colors$compartment,
                                   sex = colors$sex,
                                   age = colors$ageAtDraw)
)

showRowNames = length(labels) < 30

hm = Heatmap(tp, 
             show_column_names = FALSE, 
             show_row_names = showRowNames, 
             cluster_columns = FALSE, 
             name = "z scaled pct parent", # legend 
             top_annotation = ha, 
             col = colors$heatmap, 
             cluster_rows = TRUE, 
             column_title = paste0("Significant populations in antigen specific compartment at T2 and T3"), # title
             show_row_dend = FALSE,
             na_col = "grey")

plot(hm)
  
png(file.path("plots/forTalk/hm_T2_and_T3.png"), height= 6, width = 9, units = "in", res = 300)
print(hm)
invisible(dev.off())

```

### Venn diagram that goes with the heatmap

```{r make venn diagram for overlap between T2 and T3}
top.table = dplyr::filter(modifierResults, timePoint %in% c("T2", "T3"), compartment == "antigen_specific", fdr <= 0.05)

x = unique(dplyr::filter(top.table, timePoint == "T2")$subset)
y = unique(dplyr::filter(top.table, timePoint == "T3")$subset)


vennT2T3 = venn.diagram(
    x = list(
      T2 = x,
      T3 = y
    ),
    category.names = c("T2", "T3"),
    filename = NULL,
    output = TRUE,
    main = paste("Dysregulated features at T2 and T3"),
    fill = colors$compartment,
    alpha = 0.5,
    cex = 1.5,
    cat.cex = 1.5,
    cat.pos = 0,
    cat.dist = 0.05,
    main.cex = 2
  )
  
# Draw the plot directly to the R plotting window
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(vennT2T3)
  
return(venn.plot)



```
