
### Now make a correlation plot
```{r make a correlation plot}
x = dplyr::filter(stats, subset %in% uniqueSubsets, timePoint %in% c("T2"), compartment == "antigen_specific") %>% select(subset, timePoint, FC, fdr)
y = dplyr::filter(stats, subset %in% uniqueSubsets, timePoint %in% c("T3"), compartment == "antigen_specific") %>% select(subset, timePoint, FC, fdr)

correlationData = merge(x, y, by = "subset", suffixes = c("_T2", "_T3"))
correlationData$maxFDR = -log10(pmax(correlationData$fdr_T2, correlationData$fdr_T3))

limits = max(abs(log2(correlationData$FC_T2)), abs(log2(correlationData$FC_T3)))

ggplot(correlationData, aes(x = log2(FC_T2), y = log2(FC_T3), color = maxFDR) ) + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  # geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
  # geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = -1, linetype = "dotted") +
  # add vertical line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  # geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(x = "logFC change at T2", y = "logFC change at T3", color = "-log10(FDR)") +
  lims(x = c(-limits, limits), y = c(-limits, limits)) +
    # use viridis color scale
  scale_color_viridis_c()

ggsave("plots/forTalk/correlationPlot_T2_and_T3.png", width = 7.5, height = 6)



```

## Advanced aging
```{r subset that shows advanced aging}
design_ = dplyr::filter(design, 
                       timePoint == "T1", 
                       compartment == "all_Bcells", 
                       # studyGroup == "TC"
                       )

for (subset_ in dplyr::filter(T1_age_tests_DS_vs_TC, fdr < 0.05)$subset) {

  data_ = data.frame(sampleName = colnames(pctParent),
                      # pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,])/100,# for beta regression
                      pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,]), # for other modeling
                      weights = as.numeric(weights[subset_,])
    )
    
    
  data_ = dplyr::filter(data_, sampleName %in% design_$sampleName)
    
  data_ = merge(data_, design, by = "sampleName")
  
  # I initially used a boring glm
  # fit <- gam(ageAtDraw ~ s(pctParent), data = data_[data_$studyGroup == "TC", ], weights = data_$weights[data_$studyGroup == "TC"])
  fit = glm(ageAtDraw ~ pctParent, data = data_[data_$studyGroup == "TC", ], weights = data_$weights[data_$studyGroup == "TC"])
  
  data_$predictedAge = predict(fit, newdata = data_)
  data_$delta = data_$predictedAge - data_$ageAtDraw
    
    
  # Get the line and confidence interval
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ pctParent,
               at = list(pctParent = seq(min(data_$pctParent), max(data_$pctParent), length.out = 50))
  )
    
  predictions <- as.data.frame(emm)
    
  predictions <- predictions %>%
      rename(fit = emmean) %>%
      mutate(lower.CL = fit - 1.96 * SE,
             upper.CL = fit + 1.96 * SE)
    predictions$studyGroup = "TC"
    
  figs = list()
  # Overview figure 1, look if there is in age effect
  figs[[1]] = ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = ageAtDraw, y = pctParent), size = 2) +
  # geom_jitter(aes(color = patientType), size = 2, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Age at Draw", y = "Percent parent", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age dependence of ", subset_) ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
  # ylim(0, 100)

figs[[1]]
  
  # Overview two, plot predicted age by percent parent
figs[[2]] = ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(y = pctParent, xmin = lower.CL, xmax = upper.CL, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = predictions, aes(y = pctParent, x = fit, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4) +
  geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, y = pctParent, x = ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "Percent parent", x = "Age at draw", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age prediction based on pct parent for ", subset_) ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
  
  
  figs[[2]]

  # Overview two, plot predicted age by percent parent
figs[[3]] = ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, y = fit, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4) +
  geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = pctParent, y = ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Percent parent", y = "Age at draw", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age prediction based on pct parent for ", subset_) ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
  
  
  figs[[3]]
  
  # Overview three, center around predicted age
  x = dplyr::filter(data_) %>%
    select(studyGroup, ageAtDraw, predictedAge, pctParent)
  
  figs[[4]] =  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = pctParent, y = predictedAge-ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Percent parent", y = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Difference between actual and predicted age for  ", subset_) ) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, ymin = lower.CL-fit, ymax = upper.CL-fit, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, y = 0, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4)
    
    
  figs[[4]]
  
  # Plot 4, histogram of the delta
  figs[[5]] = ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = data_, aes(x = delta, fill = studyGroup), bins = 30) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", y = "Count", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Histogram of age difference for ", subset_) ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
    
  figs[[5]]  
  
  # Plot 5 density of the delta
  figs[[6]] = ggplot(data = data_, aes(x = delta, fill = studyGroup)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", y = "Density", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Density plot of age difference for ", subset_) ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
  
  figs[[6]]
  # put all figs from list into a single plot
  
        # Plot 5 density of the delta
  figs[[7]] = ggplot(data = data_, aes(y = delta, x = studyGroup, fill = studyGroup)) +
      geom_boxplot(aes(x = studyGroup, y = delta, fill = studyGroup), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_jitter(aes(x = studyGroup, y = delta, fill = studyGroup), shape = 21, size = 2, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75))  +
      labs(x = "Group", y = "Delta age", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Boxplot difference between predicted and actual age ", subset_) ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) + 
    theme_bw()
  
  figs[[7]]
  
  fig = ggarrange(plotlist = figs, ncol = 1)
  # fig
  
  ggsave(file = paste0("plots/forTalk/aging_T1/", str_remove_all(subset_, "/"), ".png"), fig, width = 8, height = 20, units = "in", dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r subset that shows advanced aging}
  geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, y = fit, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4) +
  geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = pctParent, y = ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Percent parent", y = "Age at draw", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Age prediction based on pct parent for ", subset_) ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
  
  
  figs[[3]]
  
  # Overview three, center around predicted age
  x = dplyr::filter(data_) %>%
    select(studyGroup, ageAtDraw, predictedAge, pctParent)
  
  figs[[4]] =  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = data_, aes(color = studyGroup, x = pctParent, y = predictedAge-ageAtDraw), size = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Percent parent", y = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Difference between actual and predicted age for  ", subset_) ) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) +
    geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, ymin = lower.CL-fit, ymax = upper.CL-fit, fill = studyGroup), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = pctParent, y = 0, color = studyGroup), linewidth = 1, linetype = 4)
    
    
  figs[[4]]
  
  # Plot 4, histogram of the delta
  figs[[5]] = ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = data_, aes(x = delta, fill = studyGroup), bins = 30) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", y = "Count", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Histogram of age difference for ", subset_) ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
    
  figs[[5]]  
  
  # Plot 5 density of the delta
  figs[[6]] = ggplot(data = data_, aes(x = delta, fill = studyGroup)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Δ age (predicted - actual)", y = "Density", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Density plot of age difference for ", subset_) ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort)
  
  figs[[6]]
  
    # Plot 5 density of the delta
  figs[[7]] = ggplot(data = data_, aes(y = delta, x = studyGroup, fill = studyGroup)) +
      geom_boxplot(aes(x = studyGroup, y = delta, fill = studyGroup), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_jitter(aes(x = studyGroup, y = delta, fill = studyGroup), shape = 21, size = 2, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75))  +
      labs(x = "Group", y = "Delta age", fill = element_blank(), title = paste0("Boxplot difference between predicted and actual age ", subset_) ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$studyGroupShort) + 
    theme_bw()
  
  figs[[7]]
  # put all figs from list into a single plot
  fig = ggarrange(plotlist = figs, ncol = 1)
    
    ggsave(file = paste0("plots/forTalk/aging_", timePoint_, "_antigen_specific/", str_remove_all(subset_, "/"), ".png"), fig, width = 8, height = 20, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

# Circular plot

```{r calculate summary}
x_T1 = stats_timepoint[["T1, pre, all Bcells"]]
x_T1$timePoint = "T1"
x_T1$compartment = "global"

x_T2 = stats_timepoint[["T2, pre, all Bcells"]]
x_T2$timePoint = "T2"
x_T2$compartment = "global"

x_T3 = stats_timepoint[["T3, pre, all Bcells"]]
x_T3$timePoint = "T3"
x_T3$compartment = "global"

y_T1 = stats_timepoint[["T1, enriched, antigen specific"]]
y_T1$timePoint = "T1"
y_T1$compartment = "antigen_specific"

y_T2 = stats_timepoint[["T2, enriched, antigen specific"]]
y_T2$timePoint = "T2"
y_T2$compartment = "antigen_specific"

y_T3 = stats_timepoint[["T3, enriched, antigen specific"]]
y_T3$timePoint = "T3"
y_T3$compartment = "antigen_specific"


stats = rbind(x_T1, x_T2, x_T3, y_T1, y_T2, y_T3)
stats = dplyr::filter(stats, depth >= 1)
stats$leafNode = stats$terminal_node

# summarize data, group by leafnode, studyGroup and timePoint
summary = stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(fdr < 0.05, group_1_median_count >= 10 | group_2_median_count >= 10) %>%
  group_by(leafNode, timePoint, compartment) %>%
    summarize(nLeafnodes = n())

summary_ = stats %>%
  group_by(leafNode, timePoint, compartment) %>%
    summarize(nTotalLeafnodes = n())

summary$ntotalLeafnodes = max(summary_$nTotalLeafnodes)

summary$nLeafnodes[is.na(summary$nLeafnodes)] = 0

summary_ = summary %>%
  group_by(timePoint, compartment) %>%
    summarize(nTotalSignificantLeafnodes = sum(nLeafnodes))

summary = merge(summary, summary_, by = c("timePoint", "compartment"), all = TRUE)
summary$fractionPopulated = summary$nLeafnodes / summary$nTotalSignificantLeafnodes

summary$compartment = factor(summary$compartment, levels = c("global", "antigen_specific"))
summary$timePoint = factor(summary$timePoint, levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3"))

# within each compartment and timepoint, normalize fraction Populated so 


# make a barplot

ggplot(summary) + 
    geom_bar(aes(x = leafNode, y = fractionPopulated, fill = leafNode), stat = "identity") + 
    facet_wrap(compartment~timePoint, scales = "free") +
    coord_polar() +
    theme_bw() + 
    # theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = annotationColors$leafNode) + 
    labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "Leaf node") + 
    ggtitle("Terminal nodes that drive changes in DS vs TC in RO+ T cells") +
    # center title
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    # make x tick text fontz smaller
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6))

ggsave("../plots/Bcells/circularPlot_leafNodes_from_stats_DS_vs_TC.png", width = 11, height = 8.5, dpi = 500)
ggsave("../plots/Bcells/circularPlot_leafNodes_from_stats_DS_vs_TC.pdf", width = 11, height = 8.5)

```
